opening.argument: The video gives viewers operational instructions to find and open the Forsage application, create an account, invest $15, and join members for promised monetary gain. It states, “After you invest in this team, you get more $,” and explains, “You can join a few members only with a $15 plan.” It then invites participation: “If you want to create an account with this, join this company.” These instructions make investment, membership, and recruitment central to the offer. Although the ASR contains a contradictory caution, the surrounding directions and explicit invitation promote participation in the scheme.
